description: Whole-protein insertion-energy profiles showing no alternative membrane anchor downstream, plus the family N-terminal comparison table
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
par=requests.get(S,params={"query":"(gene:AADAC OR gene:AADACL2 OR gene:AADACL3 OR gene:AADACL4 OR gene:NCEH1) AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true","format":"json","size":20},timeout=60).json()["results"]
P={e.get("genes",[{}])[0].get("geneName",{}).get("value"):e["sequence"]["value"] for e in par}
HE=dict(A=0.11,C=-0.13,D=3.49,E=2.68,F=-0.32,G=0.74,H=2.06,I=-0.60,K=2.71,L=-0.55,M=-0.10,N=2.05,P=2.23,Q=2.36,R=2.58,S=0.84,T=0.52,V=-0.31,W=0.30,Y=0.68)
dG=lambda s: sum(HE.get(c,0) for c in s)
def prof(seq,L=19):
    return np.array([i+1 for i in range(len(seq)-L+1)]), np.array([dG(seq[i:i+L]) for i in range(len(seq)-L+1)])

print("=== Is there any alternative membrane anchor downstream of a putative cleavage site? ===")
rows=[]
for g in ["AADACL4","AADACL3","AADACL2","AADAC","NCEH1"]:
    s=P[g]; x,y=prof(s)
    nterm=y[x<=27]; rest=y[x>=30]
    rows.append(dict(gene=g,L=len(s),
        best_Nterm_dG=round(float(nterm.min()),2), pos_Nterm=int(x[x<=27][nterm.argmin()]),
        best_downstream_dG=round(float(rest.min()),2), pos_downstream=int(x[x>=30][rest.argmin()]),
        windows_downstream_below_0=int((rest<0).sum())))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(D.to_string(index=False))
print("\nA window needs dG well below 0 to insert. Downstream minima are all positive, so no second membrane anchor exists:")
print("if the N-terminal segment were removed by signal peptidase, the mature chain would be a soluble protein.")

# ---- figure: dG profile of the family N-terminal region ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,4.6))
COL={"AADACL4":"#C8102E","AADACL3":"#E87722","AADACL2":"#7A52C7","AADAC":"#1B7F79","NCEH1":"#1F4E9C"}
for g in COL:
    x,y=prof(P[g]); m=x<=60
    ax[0].plot(x[m],y[m],color=COL[g],lw=2,label=g)
ax[0].axhline(0,color="k",lw=.8)
ax[0].axhspan(-5,0,color="#A8C8A0",alpha=.25)
ax[0].text(45,-3.3,"membrane-insertion competent",fontsize=8,color="#2F5D2F")
ax[0].set_xlabel("start residue of 19-residue window")
ax[0].set_ylabel("summed Hessa value (kcal/mol proxy)")
ax[0].set_title("a  N-terminal insertion-energy profile, human AADAC family")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
for g in COL:
    x,y=prof(P[g]); ax[1].plot(x,y,color=COL[g],lw=1.1,alpha=.85,label=g)
ax[1].axhline(0,color="k",lw=.8)
ax[1].set_xlabel("start residue of 19-residue window"); ax[1].set_ylabel("summed Hessa value")
ax[1].set_title("b  Whole-protein profile: the only insertion-competent segment is at the N terminus")
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,ncol=2)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---- paralog determinant comparison table (curation artifact) ----
tab=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(gene="AADACL4",uniprot_Nterm_call="TM 5-25, signal-anchor type II (ECO:0000255)",cytosolic_KR="none",acidic_lumenal_turn="Glu26, Asp32",dG19=-2.61,p_SP=0.22,NxST_sequons="168, 269",catalytic_Ser=193,PE="3 inferred from homology"),
 dict(gene="AADACL3",uniprot_Nterm_call="no signal peptide, no TM feature",cytosolic_KR="none",acidic_lumenal_turn="none",dG19=-2.37,p_SP=0.18,NxST_sequons="none",catalytic_Ser=193,PE="2 transcript level"),
 dict(gene="AADACL2",uniprot_Nterm_call="Signal peptide 1-18 (ECO:0000255)",cytosolic_KR="Lys4",acidic_lumenal_turn="Asp25, Glu28, Glu29",dG19=2.28,p_SP=0.84,NxST_sequons="282, 323",catalytic_Ser=189,PE="1 protein level"),
 dict(gene="AADAC",uniprot_Nterm_call="TM 6-23, signal-anchor type II (ECO:0000255)",cytosolic_KR="Arg3, Lys4",acidic_lumenal_turn="Asp25, Glu28, Glu29",dG19=1.70,p_SP=0.05,NxST_sequons="78, 282",catalytic_Ser=189,PE="1 protein level"),
 dict(gene="NCEH1",uniprot_Nterm_call="TM 5-25, signal-anchor type II (ECO:0000255)",cytosolic_KR="Arg2",acidic_lumenal_turn="Asp29",dG19=0.82,p_SP=0.57,NxST_sequons="270, 287, 389",catalytic_Ser=191,PE="1 protein level"),
])
print("\n=== family comparison table ===")
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
tab.to_csv("aadac_family_Nterminal_comparison.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved aadac_family_Nterminal_comparison.csv")
